subject: Storage zones that improve kitchen flow
hook: Put the plates one step from the dishwasher and unloading stops being a chore.
ig:
Put the plates one step from the dishwasher and unloading stops being a chore.

Of all the storage zones in a kitchen, crockery and cutlery get used the most. Yet in a lot of kitchens they sit on the far side of the room, so every unload is a walk back and forth with stacked plates.

The fix is simple to plan:
• Cutlery drawer with an insert directly beside the dishwasher
• Everyday plates and bowls in a deep drawer just below, so you lift them out rather than reaching up
• Glasses and mugs in the nearest wall unit or a tall unit next to it

The best-loved items get the best spot. Serving dishes and the Christmas platter can live further away.

Is your cutlery drawer near the dishwasher, or on the other side of the kitchen? Tell us in the comments.

If it is across the room, you will know the shuffle: one handful of forks at a time, then back for the plates. When we plan a bespoke kitchen, the crockery and cutlery zone goes right next to the dishwasher, with a cutlery insert in the top drawer and deep drawers for everyday plates below. Unloading becomes one standing spot instead of a walk.
